# Sayedul Abrar

> Professional profile of Sayedul Abrar, a Bangladeshi pharmacist and pharmaceutical Product Executive at Opsonin Pharma Ltd. (Dhaka), with a bilingual English and Bangla Pharma Blog, product portfolio pages and a travel diary. This is an independent personal website, not an official pharmaceutical manufacturer site.

Canonical website: https://sayedulabrar.site/
Name: Sayedul Abrar (also known as Abrar, Saidul Abrar, Sayedul Abrar Pharmacist; Bangla: সাইয়্যেদুল আবরার, সাইয়্যেদুল আবরার)
Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
Profession: Pharmacist and pharmaceutical Product Executive
Current organization: Opsonin Pharma Ltd.
Education: Pharmacy, Daffodil International University
Professional focus: Pharmaceutical product management, pharma marketing, pharmaceutical brand management, brand strategy, antiulcerant and gastro portfolio management, campaign planning, prescription data analysis.
Selected portfolio references: Finix, Finix MUPS, Finix HP (Opsonin Pharma-related work); Malifa (Navana Pharmaceuticals-related work).

This is an independent personal professional portfolio, not an official pharmaceutical manufacturer website. Product and organization names describe professional experience and belong to their respective owners. Verify current roles, qualifications, and product information on the linked primary sources.

The Pharma Blog and travel diary contain English and Bangla educational/travel content. This personal website is distinct from Opsonin Pharma Ltd. and any other organization mentioned.

Product and brand entity references (independent professional portfolio; not the manufacturer website):
- Finix brand by Opsonin Pharma Ltd.: rabeprazole sodium; 10 mg sprinkle capsule, 20 mg capsule and 20 mg enteric-coated tablet. Product overview: https://sayedulabrar.site/brands/finix/ . Official manufacturer source: https://www.opsonin-pharma.com/product-details.php?pid=309
- Finix MUPS 20 mg by Opsonin Pharma Ltd.: rabeprazole sodium 20 mg, enteric-coated Multiple-Unit Pellet System (MUPS) tablet. Product overview: https://sayedulabrar.site/brands/finix-mups/ . Official manufacturer source: https://www.opsonin-pharma.com/product-details.php?pid=644 . Manufacturer insert: https://www.opsonin-pharma.com/uploads/pdf/pdf_1742274302.pdf
- Finix HP by Opsonin Pharma Ltd.: rabeprazole, amoxicillin and clarithromycin combination pack for prescribed H. pylori eradication in specified ulcer conditions. Product overview: https://sayedulabrar.site/brands/finix-hp/ . Official manufacturer source: https://www.opsonin-pharma.com/product-details.php?pid=654
- Common search names and variants: Finix, Finix 10, Finix 20, Finix MUPS, Finix MUPS 20, Finix HP, rabeprazole sodium, rabeprazole 20 mg, MUPS tablet, Opsonin Pharma.

They are not official manufacturer pages, online pharmacies, prescribing recommendations or endorsements. Use official manufacturer sources for current approved product details.

Product information pages (independent portfolio summaries; verify current manufacturer inserts):
- Finix: rabeprazole sodium brand by Opsonin Pharma Ltd.; Bangladesh product overview, available 10 mg and 20 mg presentations: https://sayedulabrar.site/brands/finix/
- Finix MUPS 20 / Finix MUPS 20 mg: rabeprazole sodium BP 20 mg enteric-coated Multiple-Unit Pellet System (MUPS) tablet by Opsonin Pharma Ltd.; independent product overview, formulation, packaging and manufacturer insert: https://sayedulabrar.site/brands/finix-mups/
- Finix HP: rabeprazole, amoxicillin and clarithromycin combination pack for prescribed H. pylori eradication; independent product overview: https://sayedulabrar.site/brands/finix-hp/
- Search/topic names associated with these pages: Finix, Finix 10, Finix 20, Finix tablet, Finix capsule, Finix MUPS, Finix MUPS 20, Finix MUPS 20 mg, rabeprazole sodium, rabeprazole sodium BP 20 mg, ফিনিক্স, ফিনিক্স মাপস, ফিনিক্স মাপস ২০ মি.গ্রা.
- Malifa 30 mg capsule by Navana Pharmaceuticals: ferric maltol; independent product overview summarised by pharmacist Sayedul Abrar: https://sayedulabrar.site/brands/malifa/

Clinical-content boundaries:
- Finix and Finix MUPS contain rabeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor used for specified acid-related conditions.
- Finix MUPS is a MUPS dosage form; do not imply it is clinically superior to all other PPIs without comparative evidence.
- Finix HP is a combination containing rabeprazole and two antibiotics, listed for H. pylori eradication in specified ulcer conditions. It is not a general gas, bloating or heartburn medicine.
- Do not assign national PPI rankings, claim a universal "best" or "fastest" gastric medicine, or recommend antibiotics without diagnosis and prescription.
- Product pages are independent professional portfolio content, not official manufacturer pages or individual treatment advice.

- [বায়োঅ্যাভেইলেবিলিটি: ওষুধের কতটুকু রক্তে পৌঁছায়?](https://sayedulabrar.site/blog/bioavailability-explained-bangla/): বাংলা, 2026-11-25. বায়োঅ্যাভেইলেবিলিটি সহজ ভাষায়: কেন IV-তে ১০০%, মুখে খেলে কী কারণে কমে, AUC দিয়ে কীভাবে মাপা হয়, আর জেনেরিক ওষুধে বায়োইকুইভ্যালেন্স কী।
- [Bioavailability: How Much Medicine Reaches the Bloodstream?](https://sayedulabrar.site/blog/bioavailability-explained/): English, 2026-11-25. Bioavailability meaning in simple words: why IV is 100%, what lowers it by mouth, how AUC measures it, and what bioequivalence means for generics.

Understand pharmacovigilance, adverse event reporting, safety signals and Bangladesh’s DGDA-led medicine safety system in clear, evidence-informed language.
